name: canli-validation-mcp
description: Check a backtest before you trust it: deflated Sharpe, backtest overfitting (CSCV), paper-evidence and breadth, each with a recomputable receipt.
long_description: Tools over canlicapital.com's free validation API. Every result is the full API envelope, including the sentences that say what a number does not establish. Also reads a company's SEC-reported financial history. Your returns are not stored: the API keeps a SHA-256 hash of the input and the verdict.
